## Context
Describe the current behavior and the expected result. For a bug, include reproduction steps and the affected version or commit. Do not include secrets or personal data.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable result that confirms this change is complete.

## Validation
Which tests or smoke checks demonstrate the result? State required tooling; contributing and CI must work without AWS credentials.

## Risks
Affected behavior, compatibility, data or operational risks. Use “none identified” when appropriate.

## Links and dependencies
Related issues, evidence and prerequisite PRs. Keep each delivery small and independently reviewable.
